main_measure.name: mean short-direction 21-bar excess move of deep cases (forecast <= -10)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passed; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 20 deep cases

supporting_check.name: deep mean minus shallow mean short-direction excess move (> 0 passes)

decided_by: The t of the deep cases' mean lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Grid bars are positions 0, 21, 42, ... of each window with a full 21-bar return inside it; the coin's drift is the mean of all its grid returns over all its windows; the day t uses per-day sums of deviations from the case mean with a K/(K-1) correction; the situation is a negative raw 30-day return with a negative forecast; fewer than 20 deep cases is reported as not observable.
